scenes.title: Act 01 - The Merchant Problem & Live Seed State
scenes.script: Small businesses lose thousands of dollars and hours every month chasing unpaid invoices, reconciling subscriptions, and manually defending buyer disputes. Meet PayPulse: an autonomous AI CFO, deal desk, and dispute shield built on live PayPal Sandbox APIs and AG Studio 3.1. Our merchant book starts with 7,920 dollars invoiced, 4,710 dollars collected, 2,750 dollars overdue, and a 59.5 percent collection rate.

scenes.title: Act 02 - Command Center & AG Studio 3.1 Relational Analytics
scenes.script: Inside the Command Center, PayPulse pipes live receivables, customer loyalty tiers, and recurring subscriptions into an embedded AG Studio 3.1 canvas. Relational joins connect invoices and subscriptions to customers, while calculated expressions compute collection rate and outstanding balance in real time across Executive Cashflow, Overdue and Buy Now Pay Later, and Subscription presets.

scenes.title: Act 03 - Deal Desk Happy Path: Live Invoicing, Orders & QR
scenes.script: Moving to the Deal Desk, the Deal and Billing Agent converts natural language into live PayPal Sandbox mutations. Watch as our local Ollama model processes the request to bill Alex Mercer 450 dollars for an AI Vision Pipeline milestone. In the background, PayPulse attaches an idempotent PayPal Request ID header, dispatches a live PayPal Sandbox invoice, creates a matching Checkout Order, and renders a scannable PayPal QR code.

scenes.title: Act 04 - Recurring Subscriptions & Deterministic-First Reliability
scenes.script: Next, we instruct our local Ollama model to launch a 79 dollar monthly Enterprise AI Retainer plan. PayPulse provisions a live PayPal Catalog Product and Billing Subscription Plan in seconds. Because PayPulse is deterministic-first and AI-optional, even if local Ollama is offline, our deterministic router guarantees zero-downtime execution.

scenes.title: Act 05 - Collections Nudge-Bot & 50% Pay Later Split
scenes.script: To recover overdue cash without sending robotic reminder spam, the Collections Nudge-Bot targets our largest overdue invoice: PP-2026-005 for Priya Nair at FinEdge Global, overdue by 1,600 dollars. With one click, the agent drafts a customer-facing recovery note, creates a 50 percent milestone split invoice for 800 dollars, and attaches a PayPal Pay Later checkout order.

scenes.title: Act 06 - Webhook Room: Autonomous Dispute Shield & Unhappy Paths
scenes.script: In the Webhook Room, the Dispute-Shield Agent defends the unhappy path autonomously. First, when a 480 dollar Item Not Received dispute arrives, the agent verifies carrier delivery and uploads multipart tracking evidence to PayPal's Disputes API. Second, when an 18 dollar and 50 cent refund claim arrives below our 25 dollar threshold, it auto-refunds the capture to avoid a 15 dollar dispute fee. Third, a 74 dollar denied capture is escalated, and a paid invoice webhook reconciles our ledger live.

scenes.title: Act 07 - 3D Isometric Architecture & Partner Ecosystem Matrix
